topic: Routine servicing, supervision/ execution of servicing/ suspension/ forecast determination as per UE utilization rate, servicing of aircraft
syllabus_extract: Routine servicing, supervision/ execution of servicing/ suspension/ forecast determination as per UE utilization rate, servicing of aircraft in storage
specific_objectives: 1.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to enumerate various servicing schedules on naval aircraft and defect reporting procedure.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of defect reporting card filling and utilization rate calculation; Safety: PPE usage; Supervision: Instructor monitors accuracy of entries.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of routine servicing?
Define Utilization Equivalent (UE) in the context of maintenance.
List three common defects found during routine servicing.

development.content:
Routine servicing schedules
Defect reporting procedure
Servicing execution supervision
Suspension criteria
Forecast determination

UE utilization rate calculation
Forecasting maintenance needs
Suspension of servicing protocols
Storage servicing requirements
Defect reporting workflow

Review of defect reporting forms
Application of UE rates
Storage servicing checklist
Supervision techniques
Suspension authorization process

summary_questions: Explain how UE utilization rate influences the forecast of servicing requirements.
Describe the procedure for suspending routine servicing based on operational status.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the servicing schedule for a naval aircraft in storage, referencing the procedures to be covered in LP 02.
